Ben (Eng): Hey team - quick Q after accepting an external offer. Can I roll over my 401k after my termination date or do I need to do anything before I leave?
Samira (People Ops): Congrats on the move! :tada: You can complete a rollover after separation. A few things to check first: any outstanding loans, whether the vendor requires termination confirmation to unlock options, and timing for final distributions.
Ben (Eng): I have an active loan (~$6k). Does that prevent a rollover?
Samira (People Ops): Not necessarily. If the loan isn't repaid, many plans treat the unpaid amount as a deemed distribution (taxable). Some vendors will offset the loan against the balance and give you a reduced rollover amount. Best to confirm with the vendor.
Ben (Eng): Which vendor do we use again? Can't find the portal link.
Samira (People Ops): We're with Guideline. Portal: https://login.guideline.com/companies/redwood-inference - Guideline will email you post-termination with the election form.
Ben (Eng): If Guideline offsets the loan, is there a tax hit?
Jules (Payroll): If the loan is treated as a deemed distribution, that portion is taxable and could incur a 10% early withdrawal penalty if you're under 59.5. Trustee-to-trustee rollovers avoid taxes, but an offset portion usually becomes taxable.
Ben (Eng): Can I arrange to have the loan paid out of my final paycheck?
Jules (Payroll): We can set up a one-time payroll deduction for loan repayment, but we need notice before final payroll runs. Send me the exact amount and written consent and I'll process it.
Ben (Eng): Final payroll is in 48 hours. How do I request the deduction?
Samira (People Ops): DM Jules with amount, employee ID, and permission. I'll also notify Guideline of your separation date so they don't auto-proceed.
Ben (Eng): DMing now with details. One more: if I choose to rollover to my new employer's plan, any special steps?
Samira (People Ops): Guideline will include rollover instructions. For a direct rollover to your new employer plan, choose trustee-to-trustee transfer to avoid withholding. If they send a check to you personally, federal law may require 20% withholding.
PlanBot: [system] Note: rollover processing times can vary; expect vendor processing 7-14 business days after election received.
Ben (Eng): Thanks. Also curious about vested vs. unvested match - does that affect what I can roll?
Samira (People Ops): Only vested amounts can be rolled. Your current vesting schedule is in the Guideline portal under "Plan Documents". If you have any pending vesting events, those will be applied as of your termination date.
Jules (Payroll): Quick payroll note: if we process a final deduction that fully repays the loan, Guideline should show no outstanding loan and your rollover amount will be the full vested balance. I'll confirm once I process it.
Ben (Eng): Appreciate it. Will follow up if anything changes.
Samira (People Ops): We'll post confirmation here once payroll and Guideline updates are done. Good luck at the new gig! :rocket:
